Who decides whether
access is granted?

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
DAC
the resource OWNER
'I'll share my file
with whoever I like'

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
MAC
the SYSTEM, from labels
'your clearance is too
low, nobody can override'

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
RBAC
the ROLE you hold
'nurses get the
medicine cabinet'

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

ABAC
ATTRIBUTES, checked live
'owner AND own phone AND
home country AND daytime'
